name: tnsaints-worker
description: Registration API for Tennessee Saints Basketball Academy evaluations

scripts.db:dump:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="SELECT * FROM registrations ORDER BY id"
scripts.db:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="DELETE FROM parent_feedback; DELETE FROM parent_messages; DELETE FROM decisions; DELETE FROM decision_batches; DELETE FROM eval_notes_internal; DELETE FROM eval_feedback; DELETE FROM registrations; DELETE FROM players; DELETE FROM email_budget;"
scripts.staff:list: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --remote --command="SELECT email_norm, display_name, author_label, role, active FROM staff ORDER BY role, email_norm"
scripts.staff:list:local: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --local --command="SELECT email_norm, display_name, author_label, role, active FROM staff ORDER BY role, email_norm"
scripts.audit:tail: wrangler d1 execute tnsaints --remote --command="SELECT at, actor, action, subject_type, subject_id FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40"
scripts.test:local: npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_acceptance.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_cancellation.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_concurrency.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_admin_auth.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_eval_capture.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_decisions.py && npm run db:reset:local && python tests/test_send_path.py && npm run db:reset:local
